payload.text: The Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to reduce electrolyte crossover, a major aging pathway in sodium-flow systems. The independent audit established the governing cycle-life figure at 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity threshold. It confirmed a gravimetric energy density of 148 Wh/kg and an operating-temperature floor of 4 °C, below which the dopant precipitates and cycling must stop. At a projected 500 MWh manufacturing scale, the stack-level cost is $61/kWh.
